ticker_news.title: Nasdaq 100’s October High Is Back in Sight After a Clean Upside Breakout
ticker_news.description: The Nasdaq 100 has broken out of a multi-week consolidation to the upside, moving above former resistance levels that had capped rallies since October. The index is now targeting its October record high of 26,399, with positive technical momentum. However, geopolitical tensions with Iran, volatile USD movements, and mixed corporate earnings are keeping investors cautious. Meta surged on strong guidance, while Microsoft and SAP declined on disappointing cloud growth outlooks.
ticker_news.author: Fawad Razaqzada

ticker_news.title: 3 Wealth-Building Vanguard ETFs to Buy Hand Over Fist in 2026
ticker_news.description: The article recommends three Vanguard ETFs as effective wealth-building investments: the Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF (VTI) with a 0.03% expense ratio tracking overall market performance, the Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIG) focusing on dividend-growth stocks, and the Vanguard International High Dividend Yield ETF (VYMI) offering international diversification with a 3% yield. With an average annualized return of just under 10%, investing $500 monthly could yield a million-dollar portfolio in 30 years.
ticker_news.author: Matt Frankel, Cfp

ticker_news.title: 1 Beaten-Down AI Stock to Buy and Hold Forever
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms is presented as an undervalued AI stock opportunity despite recent market underperformance. The company's strong social media ecosystem with 3.5 billion daily active users, combined with AI-powered advertising improvements, positions it well for growth. While concerns exist about massive AI spending and potential margin pressure, Meta's ability to pivot strategy and its lowest forward P/E ratio among Magnificent Seven peers make it attractive for long-term investors.
ticker_news.author: Prosper Junior Bakiny

ticker_news.title: AI Assistants Head into 2026 on a High Note: Comscore Reports Triple-Digit Growth on Mobile
ticker_news.description: Comscore reports that mobile visitation to AI assistant destinations reached 54.3M unique visitors in December 2025, up 107% YoY, with desktop reaching 83.0M (+18% YoY). ChatGPT leads on both platforms, while Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity show triple-digit growth rates on mobile. The data highlights mobile as the accelerating access point for AI assistants.
ticker_news.author: Comscore

ticker_news.title: Streaming Media Device Market to Reach $182.12 Billion by 2030 Amid AI Integration
ticker_news.description: The streaming media device market is projected to grow from $80.59 billion in 2025 to $94.25 billion in 2026 (16.9% CAGR), reaching $182.12 billion by 2030 (17.9% CAGR). Growth drivers include 5G connectivity expansion, subscription-based streaming adoption, AI integration, and increased smart TV penetration. Tariff-driven localization of production is supporting market resilience.
ticker_news.author: Researchandmarkets.Com

ticker_news.title: Recession in 2026? Here’s a 9% Payer to Profit
ticker_news.description: The article argues against recession fears in 2026, citing strong US GDP growth (4.4% Q3, 5%+ Q4 estimate) and AI-driven productivity gains. The author recommends Liberty All-Star Growth Fund (ASG), a 9%-yielding closed-end fund trading at a 9.8% discount to NAV, featuring blue-chip holdings like NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Apple. The discount is attributed to market pessimism despite ASG's strong 11.5% annualized NAV returns over the past decade.
ticker_news.author: Michael Foster
